methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected directly from each provider's pricing page (or, where the vendor page blocked automated access or rendered local currency, from a clearly-cited corroborating source) on the accessed date of 2026-06-13. All CRM pricing in this vertical is per-seat/per-user per month and is recorded at the annual-billing rate with the per-user note in billingModel; monthly rates and stated annual-discount percentages are captured where published. Quote-only / 'contact sales' tiers carry a null monthlyUsd, and call-center metrics (minutes, calls, overage) are null because they do not apply to CRM software.
